title: SAP QM Consultant
summary: Sets up and supports the Quality Management part of SAP so that factories can plan inspections, record results and track defects inside the same system that runs buying and production. Sits in an SAP project or support team next to the materials (MM) and production (PP) consultants, working with plant quality teams.
dailyDuties: Run workshops with plant quality teams to capture inspection needs
Configure inspection plans, characteristics and quality notifications
Set up goods receipt and in-process inspection with MM and PP consultants
Write functional specs for reports and enhancements
Write test scripts and run integration and user testing
Train key users and resolve QM support tickets

skills.expectation: Configure inspection types, inspection plans, master inspection characteristics, quality notifications and usage decisions
Set up QM in procurement: quality info records, goods receipt inspection and vendor evaluation
Link in-process and final inspection to production orders and routings
Run workshops with plant quality teams and write functional specs
Map inspection, defect and release processes as-is and to-be
Write test scripts and run integration and user acceptance testing
Train key users and explain design choices in plain words
Work with quality, procurement and production teams and ABAP developers
Load inspection plans, characteristics and info records during cutover
Understand defect recording and CAPA as the plant quality team runs them
Support SPC and sampling results recorded in SAP
Know the ISO 9001 or GMP rules the system has to support
Write specs ABAP developers can build reports and enhancements from
Resolve QM support tickets within SLA after go-live

certifications.why: Covers the production side that QM inspections hook into
